criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Donation Intent
categories.definition: Requests or offers to donate money, goods, or services related to COVID-19 relief.

categories.name: Information Seeking
categories.definition: Inquiries about COVID-19 facts, statistics, treatments, and myths.

categories.name: Health and Safety Precautions
categories.definition: Questions or statements regarding measures to protect oneself from COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: Questions or statements related to travel restrictions, safety, and protocols during the pandemic.

categories.name: Symptoms and Testing
categories.definition: Inquiries about COVID-19 symptoms, testing procedures, and personal health assessments.

categories.name: Misinformation and Myths
categories.definition: Requests for clarification or debunking of myths and misinformation about COVID-19.

categories.name: Updates and News
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news, statistics, and updates regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment Options
categories.definition: Inquiries about available treatments and remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Community Support
categories.definition: Requests for information on how to support local communities during the pandemic.

categories.name: General Interaction
categories.definition: Casual greetings or acknowledgments without specific COVID-19 intent.
